name: review-panel
description: A small code review panel: a lead, a correctness reviewer and an independent skeptic, with a managed Workflow template that starts only when you choose it.

lead.title: Review lead
lead.description: Splits the review, briefs the reviewers, merges their findings and writes the final report.

reviewer.title: Correctness reviewer
reviewer.description: Reads the change and reports concrete defects with a failing input and the line that causes it.

skeptic.title: Independent skeptic
skeptic.description: Checks the reviewer's findings and looks for what the reviewer missed, with an independent model.

ui-check.title: Interface checker
ui-check.description: Opens the changed screens in the host browser and reports visible regressions.

review-panel.title: Review panel
review-panel.description: The lead splits the change, the reviewer and the skeptic review it in parallel, and the lead reports ranked findings.
review-panel.objective: Review the current branch against its base. Report verified findings ranked by severity, each with a failing input and the line that causes it.

review-panel-ui.title: Review panel with interface check
review-panel-ui.description: The review panel plus a browser check of the changed screens.
review-panel-ui.objective: Review the current branch against its base, including the screens it changes. Report verified findings ranked by severity.
